description: List the enquiries (leads) a rikma is working on before money: people who wrote in, and concierge wish proposals the rikma is a candidate on. Each row: kind, id, name, organization, source, stage (new / contacted / talking / offered / paused), who owns it (ownerId — null means nobody took it yet), lastAt, followUpAt, nextAction and attention (unanswered / followUpDue / stale — why it needs someone). Sorted: needs attention first, then whatever waited longest. No phone or email here — open one lead for that. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#listRikmaLeadsTool

limit.description: At most this many rows, default 30.

view.description: 'open' (default): everything in play · 'attention': needs someone now · 'paused': not now · 'mine' · 'nobody': nobody took it

name: listRikmaLeadsTool
